text: Today I feel really happy and calm because I finished my exams.
I feel so lonely and sad, nothing seems to be working out.
Too much workload today, deadlines are stressing me out completely.
Feeling anxious about the interview tomorrow morning.
Had a peaceful walk by the park, feeling centered and grateful.
Things were hard in the morning, but I believe tomorrow will be better.
आज का दिन बहुत अच्छा रहा, परिवार के साथ समय बिताकर मन खुश हो गया।
आज ऑफिस में बहुत तनाव था, काम का बोझ बढ़ता ही जा रहा है।
मन बहुत उदास और अशांत है, कुछ भी अच्छा नहीं लग रहा।
कल के रिजल्ट को लेकर बहुत घबराहट और चिंता हो रही है।
Aaj mood bahut accha hai, friends ke sath dinner pe gaye the aur maza aaya.
Aaj office me bahut jyada stress tha, manager ne deadline pre-pone kar di.
Mujhe future ko lekar bahut tension aur anxiety ho rahi hai.
Thoda difficult time chal raha hai but I have full hope sab theek ho jayega.
இன்று கல்லூரி மிகவும் அமைதியாகவும் மகிழ்ச்சியாகவும் இருந்தது.
இன்று வேலை அழுத்தம் தாங்க முடியவில்லை, மிகவும் மன உளைச்சலாக உள்ளது.
Today college la romba stressful ah irundhuchu but friends kooda pesina apram konjam better feel panninen.
Inniku romba kashtama iruku, I feel very down and stressed with project work.
Exam pathi ninaichaale romba பயம் and anxiety varudhu, nothing is prepared.
Weekend nalla relax panni meditate panninen, mind is totally calm now.
ഇന്ന് എനിക്ക് വളരെ സന്തോഷം തോന്നുന്നു, എല്ലാ കാര്യങ്ങളും നന്നായി നടന്നു.
ജോലിയിൽ ഭയങ്കര സ്ട്രെസ്സ് ആണ്, ഉറങ്ങാൻ പോലും പറ്റുന്നില്ല.
Njan valare santhoshavan aanu, today was a great day with family.
Innathe divasam valare kashtapadanu, exam result orthu tension aavunnu.
Kure issues undayirunnu, ennalum nalla oru pratheeksha undu.
ఈ రోజు నాకు చాలా సంతోషంగా మరియు ప్రశాంతంగా ఉంది.
ఆఫీసులో పని ఒత్తిడి చాలా ఎక్కువగా ఉంది, చాలా అలసిపోయాను.
Chala badhaga undi, nothing is going right in life right now.
Tomorrow presentation undi, chala nervous ga tension paduthunna.
Today project complete chesamu, feeling very happy and relieved.
Starting lo chala kastam ga anipinchindi kani ipudu baga improve ayyindi.
